subject: Model mix & pricing follow-up: token volumes and target $/1M
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + ask: token volumes & target $/1M

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the chat today — really helpful to understand BrightLayer's 3-pronged usage (chat assistant, semantic search embeddings, and a small rerank pipeline). Quick recap and a couple asks so we can put together a tight pricing estimate: 

Recap: 
- Use cases: customer-facing chat (FAQ + troubleshooting), internal knowledge search (embeddings), and rerank stage for high-value search results.
- Model requirements: high-recall embeddings, cost-conscious chat (mix of shorter sessions + some long context), rerank on a smaller subset.
- Timeline: pilot in Q4, production H1 2028.

Asks (to finalize pricing/units):
1) Rough monthly token volumes by model type (chat / embeddings / rerank) — if you don’t have exact counts, ballpark ranges are fine.
2) Target unit economics: do you have a budget target expressed as $/1M tokens (or an ARR target for inference spend)?
3) Any constraints on model choices (open models only vs. commercial models) or preferred latency SLOs?

We’ll use those inputs to produce a per-model mix estimate (tokens by model), recommend quantization/instance types, and show a target $/1M token figure that meets your budget. I attached a simple worksheet you can drop numbers into.

Next steps: if you can reply with estimates today/tomorrow we’ll share an initial pricing sheet by EOD Wednesday PST.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0147

Attachment: Redwood_Pricing_Estimate.xlsx (xlsx, 42 KB)

From: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Rhonda Li <rhonda.li@brightlayer.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: token volumes & target $/1M

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below (ballpark for now):

1) Monthly token volumes (estimated):
- Chat (customer-facing assistant): ~45M input tokens, ~90M output tokens -> ~135M tokens/month
- Embeddings (semantic search + vector store updates): ~18M tokens/month (we're batching up uploads, so volume spikes quarterly)
- Rerank (100% of search queries go through lightweight model, but only top results reranked): ~7M tokens/month

2) Budget/targets:
- We're looking to spend roughly $4k–$6k/month for the pilot, with a target economy of ~$3,500 per 1M tokens as an internal ceiling for evaluation (we know this depends on model mix). For full production scale we can increase to mid-five figures/month.

3) Model constraints / SLOs:
- Prefer open models (for licensing reasons) but flexible if value is clear.
- Chat latency: p95 under 700ms desired; embeddings can be higher.

I attached the workload summary PDF. Happy to hop on a quick follow-up if that helps.

—Sam
Sam Jenkins
Head of Product, BrightLayer
sam.jenkins@brightlayer.com

Attachment: BrightLayer_ML_Workload_Summary.pdf (pdf, 128 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: token volumes & target $/1M

Sam —

Appreciate the numbers, that's super helpful. Quick notes from our side and an initial proposal for how we'd map pricing against your target: 

Initial mapping (pilot monthly volumes):
- Chat (135M tokens): recommend a mix of a cheaper chat variant for 80% of inference (fast responses, lower context) and a higher-capacity chat model for 20% (long-context/complex threads).
- Embeddings (18M tokens): use an open high-quality embedding model; we'll recommend quantized instances to lower unit cost.
- Rerank (7M tokens): small, latency-sensitive model on dedicated instances.

Target unit economics: you mentioned a $3.5k per 1M tokens ceiling for evaluation. Based on the model mix above and expected per-model unit costs, here's a high-level view (pilot):
- Chat effective blended cost: ~$2,800 per 1M tokens (mix of cheaper variant + 20% premium model)
- Embeddings effective cost: ~$900 per 1M tokens
- Rerank effective cost: ~$1,200 per 1M tokens

Given your mix, blended across all tokens this maps to roughly $1,900–$2,200 per 1M tokens (well under your $3.5k ceiling) — we'll show the detailed math in the spreadsheet.

Next steps: 
- Rishi will produce a per-model unit-cost breakdown and a version of the workbook with your volumes plugged in.
- If that looks good, we can prepare a pilot SOW (30–90 day) and provide Dedicated capacity pricing if you want predictable latency for rerank.

Can Rishi tag in here with the workbook and the per-model #s?

Thanks,
Marissa

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@brightlayer.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: token volumes & target $/1M

Hey team —

Attached is the populated worksheet and the per-model unit estimates (high-level values in the sheet). Summary here: 

Per-model unit costs (pilot, estimated):
- Chat_light (open quantized variant): $2,200 per 1M tokens
- Chat_premium (long-context variant): $5,500 per 1M tokens
- Embeddings_high-quality (quantized instance): $900 per 1M tokens
- Rerank_low-latency: $1,200 per 1M tokens

Applied to your volumes:
- Chat (135M): split 80/20 -> 108M tokens @ $2,200 -> $237.6k; 27M tokens @ $5,500 -> $148.5k
- Embeddings (18M): 18M @ $900 -> $16.2k
- Rerank (7M): 7M @ $1,200 -> $8.4k

Blended spend (pilot month): ~$410.7k -> effective ~$3,039 per 1M tokens across full mix. Notes: the blended number is above your stated $3.5k ceiling? actually below — sorry for the confusion: $3,039 is below $3,500. We're happy to run an alternate scenario with more aggressive quantization / batching to hit sub-$2k blended if that's required for pilot.

Links: pricing workbook (Drive) -> https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPricingDocs

Next recommended actions:
- Marissa: confirm pilot budget band ($400k/month range) and if you want us to prepare a pilot SOW.
- Sam/Rhonda: let us know if we should model a variant with more aggressive cost-saving (quantized-only endpoints + caching) or keep the quality mix as-is.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
